notes: Version read from cli/package-lock.json, which pins it with npm integrity sha512-dSc2Tr53dQcUGwsTinamEeoP2YXOhQrIZ+SyeuUrv4MzJOSjT/Q0qkSmX11ZwfcTbYSkIqbrgALQLhAm1yf5fA== — npm verifies that on install, so the release itself is attested upstream even though the extracted files are hashed by us. CLDR is a localisation standard, not a language survey: 322 locales against a spine of 8,837 languages. It is authoritative for what it has and SILENT about the rest, which the extractor records as not_surveyed rather than assuming left-to-right.
